title: Email Center
subtitle: Manage recipients, content, campaigns, and automated email sequences with Resend.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.importHelp: UTF-8 CSV with email, full_name, locale, and marketing_consent. Imports never start automations.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.name: Campaign name
campaigns.help: Recipients are prepared server-side and delivery continues after you close the browser.

automations.title: Automations
automations.help: New automations are disabled by default and only use verified business triggers.

settings.killSwitchHelp: Only admins can enable sending. The worker preserves the queue while disabled.

guide.title: Operating procedure
guide.domain: Add system, learn, events, and news.corelia.academy in Resend; copy the exact DNS records to Cloudflare and wait for Verified.
guide.secret: Set RESEND_API_KEY, RESEND_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET, and EMAIL_WORKER_SECRET as Supabase Edge secrets; configure Resend SMTP separately for Supabase Auth.
guide.template: Create a template, validate its variables, and publish a version before use.
guide.import: Import the CSV, review its error report, and verify marketing consent.
guide.test: Send to an internal test list and verify From, Reply-To, links, Gmail, and Outlook rendering.
guide.launch: Prepare the campaign, review exclusions and quota, then schedule or start it.
guide.safetyText: Disable sending and preserve indeterminate rows for Resend reconciliation. Do not resend while provider acceptance is unknown.

messages.imported: The file was queued for import.
messages.failed: The operation could not be completed.
